        required: true
        slot_uri: ex:age

        range: Color
        required: false
        slot_uri: ex:color

        range: string
        required: true
        slot_uri: ex:name

        required: false

        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExBoundedAnyOf0Object

      allowed: true

        minimum_cardinality: 2

        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExBoundedAnyOf1Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true

    attributes:

        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExMembersAnyOf0Object

      allowed: true

    attributes:

        multivalued: true
        range: ShapeRef0

    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExMembersAnyOf1Object
